_comment: HAND-COMPUTED, never generated -- a generated expectation would pin whatever the implementation happens to do, bugs included. Tiny cases are computed by hand in the case's 'why' field; the larger zh-TW pair's numbers were derived independently by tokenizing with arcsum.tokens.char_tokens and counting overlaps by hand-written script, never by calling rouge_n/rouge_l themselves, to keep the fixture independent of the implementation it pins.

cases.name: identical_zh_tw
cases.why: candidate == reference: every metric is a perfect match

cases.name: empty_candidate
cases.why: an empty candidate shares nothing with the reference -- all zero, not a divide-by-zero crash

cases.name: partial_overlap_toy
cases.why: candidate tokens [a,b,c], reference tokens [a,b,d]. ROUGE-1: unigram overlap {a,b}=2, cand_total=3, ref_total=3 -> P=R=F=2/3. ROUGE-2: cand bigrams {(a,b),(b,c)}, ref bigrams {(a,b),(b,d)}, overlap=1 -> P=R=F=1/2. ROUGE-L: LCS([a,b,c],[a,b,d])=[a,b] len 2 -> P=R=F=2/3.

cases.name: repeated_ngram_multiset_clipping
cases.why: candidate 'a a a' (tokens [a,a,a]), reference 'a a' (tokens [a,a]). ROUGE-1 multiset overlap = min(3,2) = 2 (NOT 1, which a naive set-intersection would wrongly give): P=2/3, R=2/2=1.0, F=0.8. ROUGE-2: cand bigrams Counter({(a,a):2}), ref bigrams Counter({(a,a):1}), overlap=min(2,1)=1: P=1/2, R=1/1=1.0, F=2/3. ROUGE-L: LCS([a,a,a],[a,a])=2: P=2/3, R=1.0, F=0.8.

cases.name: zh_tw_realistic_pair
cases.why: a realistic zh-TW candidate/reference pair. Values derived independently: tokenized with the real char_tokens(), then overlaps counted by a separate hand-written script -- never by calling rouge_n/rouge_l themselves.
cases.candidate: 會議討論辦公室搬遷案，最終決議遷至B棟大樓，預算已於會中核准。
cases.reference: 會議討論辦公室搬遷案，決議通過遷至B棟大樓，並核准相關預算。
